mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 2 consecutive months and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% MoM and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% month-over-month and real final sales (RSAFS) also increase, it signals a strengthening demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% MoM and RSAFS increases
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 5% MoM and RSAFS increases, but 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in a low-inflation regime.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances in a low-inflation regime.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) increases and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1%, it signals a supportive monetary environment for supply-side growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases and FEDFUNDS < 1%, but 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.
